successes.name: join-chain-alias-expression
successes.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 20 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 10 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS z UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 200 AS z) SELECT a.x AS y, c.z FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id JOIN c ON b.id = c.id ORDER BY y + 1

successes.name: join-chain-qualified-input
successes.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 10 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 20 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS z UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 200 AS z) SELECT a.x AS y, c.z FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id JOIN c ON b.id = c.id ORDER BY b.y + 1

successes.name: join-chain-repeated-projection
successes.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 20 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 10 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS z UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 200 AS z) SELECT a.x + 1 AS first, a.x + 1 AS second FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id JOIN c ON b.id = c.id ORDER BY a.x + 1

successes.name: join-chain-distinct-selection
successes.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 20 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 10 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS z UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 200 AS z) SELECT DISTINCT a.x AS y FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id JOIN c ON b.id = c.id ORDER BY a.x

successes.name: join-chain-using
successes.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 20 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 10 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS z UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 200 AS z) SELECT id, a.x, b.y, c.z FROM a JOIN b USING (id) JOIN c USING (id) ORDER BY id

successes.name: join-chain-left-null-extension
successes.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 20 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id) SELECT a.id, b.y FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.id = b.id JOIN c ON a.id = c.id ORDER BY a.id

successes.name: join-chain-data-pipe
successes.text: DATA a = SELECT 1 AS x; DATA b = SELECT 2 AS y; DATA c = SELECT 3 AS z; FROM a AS l |> CROSS JOIN b AS m |> CROSS JOIN c AS r |> SELECT l.x, m.y, r.z

successes.name: join-chain-cte-body
successes.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 2 AS id UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS id), joined AS (SELECT l.id FROM a AS l JOIN a AS m ON l.id = m.id JOIN a AS r ON m.id = r.id) SELECT id FROM joined ORDER BY id

successes.name: join-chain-acquired-shared-producer
successes.text: DATA seed = FROM records |> SELECT id; DATA joined = SELECT l.id FROM seed AS l JOIN seed AS m ON l.id = m.id JOIN seed AS r ON m.id = r.id; FROM joined |> ORDER BY id

refusals.name: join-chain-ambiguous
refusals.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 20 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 10 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS z UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 200 AS z) SELECT id FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id JOIN c ON b.id = c.id

refusals.name: join-chain-duplicate-range

refusals.name: join-chain-unselected-distinct-order
refusals.text: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 20 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 10 AS y), c AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 100 AS z UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS id, 200 AS z) SELECT DISTINCT a.x AS y FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id JOIN c ON b.id = c.id ORDER BY c.z
